title: M365 Stack 2
description: Ops includes VDI in an out-of-hours callout that started in another part of the bank. Users on AVD are reporting sporadic OneDrive issues: unable to sync, plus generic authentication problems.
scope: Out-of-hours: another-area callout. Sporadic OneDrive sync and generic M365 auth, reported on AVD.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward treating this as a rule-out of AVD / Virtual Team, not an AVD ownership claim. M365 and Azure portals first, then which devices are hit (AVD only vs corp physical as well). Ops and TRM if they are not already on. Microsoft as soon as the behaviour looks like one of their products. Recovery: active users on the call no longer see the issue after a fix. Safety-critical: do not say it is AVD until that is proven.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: M365 and Azure portals first, then AVD vs physical device check, then Microsoft if the product path is theirs.
Confirm Ops and TRM are on the call, then portals and device split in parallel.
Microsoft engaged early because OneDrive / auth is a Microsoft product, while VDI still only rules the platform in or out.
